% Multi-file project. Edge cases showcased:
%   - statements split across \input files (flattening / native \input resolution)
%   - \numberwithin to reset the counter per section
%   - a nested environment (align inside a theorem body)
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath, amsthm, amssymb}

\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{proposition}{Proposition}
\numberwithin{theorem}{section}
\numberwithin{proposition}{section}

\newcommand{\Z}{\mathbb{Z}}

\begin{document}

\input{sections/prelim}
\input{sections/results}

\end{document}
